screens.TAGGING_UNIQUEPATIENTID_UNIQUEABHANUMBER: Register a patient (/doctor/register) and every ABHA journey, through PatientRegistrationService: an ABHA number already linked returns that patient and creates no new record
screens.CRT_ABHA_101: Register a patient (/doctor/register) and the staff dashboard: Create ABHA with Aadhaar OTP, opens /doctor/abha/create
screens.CRT_ABHA_104: /doctor/abha/create step 1 Details: Aadhaar number, 12 digits only, masked once entered, 'Aadhaar Number is not valid' with no call
screens.CRT_ABHA_102: /doctor/abha/create step 2 Consent: terms word for word with I agree, five declarations, both confirmations with names filled; recorded in the audit trail before any call
screens.CRT_ABHA_105: /doctor/abha/create step 3 Aadhaar OTP: [redacted] digits only, ABDM's message with the masked mobile
screens.CRT_ABHA_106: /doctor/abha/create step 3 Aadhaar OTP: [redacted] OTP with a 60 second counter and two resends; each resend is a fresh send with a new txnId, as the sandbox requires
screens.CRT_ABHA_107: /doctor/abha/create step 3 Aadhaar OTP: [redacted] enables at six digits; a wrong OTP shows ABDM's message and keeps the transaction
screens.CRT_ABHA_108: /doctor/abha/create step 3 Aadhaar OTP: [redacted] mobile prefilled; the Aadhaar-linked mobile goes straight to step 5
screens.CRT_ABHA_109: /doctor/abha/create step 4 Mobile: OTP for a different communication mobile, same resend and wrong-OTP rules
screens.CRT_ABHA_112: /doctor/abha/create step 5 ABHA address: [masked], own address with rules in green or red, 'ABHA address already exists.' with two choices
screens.CRT_ABHA_113: /doctor/abha/create step 6 ABHA and card: ABHA number, address and profile details
screens.CRT_ABHA_114: /doctor/abha/create step 6 ABHA and card: card shown as ABDM returned it, Download ABHA card
screens.CRT_ABHA_116: /doctor/abha/create step 7 Save: matches by ABHA number, by mobile, name, gender and year of birth, or by record number; link, or create only when none matches
screens.VRFY_ABHA_101: /doctor/abha/verify: ABHA number, OTP to the Aadhaar-linked mobile; profile and card; mobile update Yes or No; details form with name, date of birth and gender read only; save
screens.VRFY_ABHA_201: /doctor/abha/verify: ABHA number, OTP to the mobile linked to the ABHA; same screens as VRFY_ABHA_101
screens.VRFY_ABHA_102: /doctor/abha/verify: ABHA address, Find login methods lists what ABDM offers for that address, Aadhaar OTP; profile, PHR card, details form, save
screens.VRFY_ABHA_202: /doctor/abha/verify: ABHA address, mobile OTP when ABDM lists it; same screens as VRFY_ABHA_102
screens.VRFY_ABHA_401: /doctor/abha/verify: Aadhaar number, 12 digits only, masked, 'Aadhaar Number is not valid' with no call; consent screen
screens.VRFY_ABHA_402: /doctor/abha/verify OTP step: a wrong OTP shows ABDM's message and stays on the step
screens.VRFY_ABHA_403: /doctor/abha/verify: No ABHA found, with ABDM's message and Create ABHA, which opens /doctor/abha/create at consent without asking for the Aadhaar again
screens.VRFY_ABHA_404: /doctor/abha/verify: ABHA verified, profile, card download, then save or link to the patient record
screens.VRFY_ABHA_405: /doctor/abha/verify OTP step: Resend OTP with a 60 second counter, two resends, then the limit message
screens.VRFY_ABHA_301: /doctor/abha/verify, Look up by: Mobile number: ten digits only, else 'Please enter a valid mobile number.' and no search is sent
screens.VRFY_ABHA_302: /doctor/abha/verify, Look up by: Mobile number: Search lists every ABHA on the mobile with masked ABHA number, name and gender, before any OTP
screens.VRFY_ABHA_303: /doctor/abha/verify, Look up by: Mobile number: 'ABHA details not found...' with a Create ABHA button that carries the mobile over, and no OTP step
screens.VRFY_ABHA_304: /doctor/abha/verify, Look up by: Mobile number: Send OTP appears only after one account is chosen; the choice is kept to verification; resend rules as on the other logins
screens.VRFY_ABHA_305: /doctor/abha/verify, Look up by: Mobile number: OTP step, then the chosen profile only, with the shared profile and card view
screens.VRFY_ABHA_306: /doctor/abha/verify, Look up by: Mobile number: shared details form, name, date of birth and gender read only; saved through PatientRegistration
screens.VRFY_ABHA_307: /doctor/abha/verify, Look up by: Mobile number: a wrong OTP shows ABDM's message, opens no profile, and can be retried
screens.VRFY_ABHA_308: /doctor/abha/verify, Look up by: Mobile number: save step shows 'This ABHA profile is already linked to HMIS Beneficiary ID.' with the ABHA's details beside the record's, and offers no new record
screens.SHARE_PATIENT_PROFILE_701: POST /api/v3/hip/patient/share registers the patient from the shared profile with no desk input and replies on on-share with the counter's token; /doctor/counters shows the QR code and the queue
screens.SHARE_PATIENT_PROFILE_702: POST /api/v3/hip/patient/share matches a returning patient, updates the ABHA address, keeps one active entry per counter and opens a new one for another counter; /doctor/counters shows both queues
